concerns.text: The plan uses `statsmodels.stats.power.FTestPower` to perform a power analysis targeting an effect size corresponding to R² = 0.6. This F‑test power calculation assumes a linear regression model with normally distributed errors, whereas the downstream model is a non‑linear Random Forest. Applying a linear‑model‑based power analysis to justify sample size for a Random Forest can be misleading and may over‑ or under‑estimate the true power. The methodology should either (a) use a power analysis appropriate for non‑parametric/ensemble models (e.g., simulation‑based power estimation) or (b) acknowledge the limitation and adjust the success‑criterion justification accordingly.
